facts.fact: Algérie Éco, citing GIE Monétique, says interbank mobile payment DZ Mob Pay launched officially in January 2025 and had 95,014 personal accounts and 14,283 merchant accounts at end December 2025.
Algérie Éco, citing GIE Monétique, says DZ Mob Pay interbank payments rest on the national mobile switch put in service in June 2024, with seven pilot banks.
